name: Arctic Druid
summary: A guardian of frozen wilderness who moves across ice, reshapes fire as cold, and becomes living snow.

features.name: Arctic Native
features.summary: In cold or icy terrain, add half Druid level to initiative and key exploration skills and leave no trail.

features.name: Icewalking
features.summary: Ignore snowy and icy movement and skill penalties and cross snow crusts or thin ice safely.

features.name: Arctic Endurance
features.summary: Ignore cold-climate effects and become immune to being dazzled.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.summary: Gain Wild Shape using an effective Druid level two lower.
features.scaling: 1 use per day; effective Druid level -2

features.name: Wild Shape
features.summary: Gain a second daily use and forms available to a 6th-level Druid.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.summary: Gain a third daily use and forms available to an 8th-level Druid.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.summary: Gain a fourth daily use and forms available to a 10th-level Druid.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.summary: Gain a fifth daily use and forms available to a 12th-level Druid.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.summary: Gain an eighth daily use; the reduced effective level does not reach at-will Wild Shape.

features.name: Snowcaster
features.summary: See through magical and natural snowstorms and prepare fire-subtype Druid spells as cold spells.

features.name: Flurry Form
features.summary: Assume a gaseous column of snow at will and add Druid level to Stealth in cold terrain.
